title: त्रयोदशाधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 213 · The bride-gifts and the birth of Abhimanyu

summary.en: Krishna defends Arjuna's choice as worthy, and the Vrishnis bring Arjuna back and celebrate the wedding. Arjuna returns to Indraprastha, Draupadi accepts Subhadra, and Krishna arrives with lavish gifts; Subhadra bears Abhimanyu, and Draupadi bears a son to each of the five brothers.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನನ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಯೋಗ್ಯವೆಂದು ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಸಮರ್ಥಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ವೃಷ್ಣಿಗಳು ಅರ್ಜುನನನ್ನು ಮರಳಿ ಕರೆತಂದು ವಿವಾಹ ಆಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಇಂದ್ರಪ್ರಸ್ಥಕ್ಕೆ ಮರಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ಸುಭದ್ರೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಅಪಾರ ಕಾಣಿಕೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಸುಭದ್ರೆ ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯುವನ್ನು ಹೆರುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ಐವರಿಗೂ ಒಬ್ಬೊಬ್ಬ ಮಗನನ್ನು ಹೆರುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: श्रीकृष्ण अर्जुन के चुनाव को उचित बताते हैं, और वृष्णि अर्जुन को लौटाकर विवाह मनाते हैं। अर्जुन इन्द्रप्रस्थ लौटते हैं, द्रौपदी सुभद्रा को अपनाती हैं, और श्रीकृष्ण प्रचुर उपहार लेकर आते हैं; सुभद्रा अभिमन्यु को जन्म देती हैं, और द्रौपदी पाँचों भाइयों से एक-एक पुत्र पाती हैं।
summary.te: అర్జునుని ఎంపిక యోగ్యమైనదని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు సమర్థిస్తాడు; వృష్ణులు అర్జునుని తిరిగి తీసుకువచ్చి వివాహం జరుపుతారు. అర్జునుడు ఇంద్రప్రస్థానికి తిరిగివస్తాడు, ద్రౌపది సుభద్రను స్వీకరిస్తుంది, శ్రీకృష్ణుడు అపార కానుకలతో వస్తాడు; సుభద్ర అభిమన్యుని కంటుంది, ద్రౌపది ఐదుగురికీ ఒక్కొక్క కుమారుని కంటుంది.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனனின் தேர்வு தகுதியானது என்று ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் ஆதரிக்க, வ்ருஷ்ணிகள் அர்ஜுனனைத் திரும்ப அழைத்துத் திருமணம் கொண்டாடுகிறார்கள். அர்ஜுனன் இந்திரப்ரஸ்தம் திரும்ப, திரௌபதி ஸுபத்ரையை ஏற்கிறாள், ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் பெரும் பரிசுகளுடன் வருகிறார்; ஸுபத்ரை அபிமன்யுவைப் பெறுகிறாள், திரௌபதி ஐவருக்கும் ஒவ்வொரு மகனைப் பெறுகிறாள்.
summary.ml: അർജുനന്റെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പ് യോഗ്യമാണെന്ന് കൃഷ്ണൻ വാദിക്കുന്നു; വൃഷ്ണികൾ അർജുനനെ തിരികെ കൊണ്ടുവന്ന് വിവാഹം ആഘോഷിക്കുന്നു. അർജുനൻ ഇന്ദ്രപ്രസ്ഥത്തിലേക്ക് മടങ്ങുന്നു; ദ്രൗപദി സുഭദ്രയെ സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നു, കൃഷ്ണൻ ഗംഭീര സമ്മാനങ്ങളുമായി എത്തുന്നു; സുഭദ്ര അഭിമന്യുവിനെ പ്രസവിക്കുന്നു, ദ്രൗപദി അഞ്ചു സഹോദരന്മാർക്കും ഓരോ പുത്രന്മാരെ പ്രസവിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.213; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
उक्तवन्तो यदा वाक्यमसकृत्सर्ववृष्णयः ।
ततोऽब्रवीद्वासुदेवो वाक्यं धर्मार्थसंहितम् ॥

meaning.en: When all the Vrishnis had spoken again and again, Vasudeva then spoke words grounded in dharma and prudence.

verses.text:
नावमानं कुलस्यास्य गुडाकेशः प्रयुक्तवान् ।
संमानोऽभ्यधिकस्तेन प्रयुक्तोऽयमसंशयम् ॥

meaning.en: Gudakesha has shown no disrespect to this family; he has surely shown it the greater honor.

verses.text:
अर्थलुब्धान्न वः पार्थो मन्यते सात्वतान्सदा ।
स्वयंवरमनाधृष्यं मन्यते चापि पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: Partha does not think of you Sattvatas as greedy for wealth, but the Pandava holds a svayamvara to be risky and uncertain.

verses.text:
प्रदानमपि कन्यायाः पशुवत्कोऽनुमंस्यते ।
विक्रयं चाप्यपत्यस्य कः कुर्यात्पुरुषो भुवि ॥

meaning.en: Who would approve the giving of a girl like a beast, and what man on earth would make a sale of his own child?

verses.text:
एतान्दोषांश्च कौन्तेयो दृष्टवानिति मे मतिः ।
अतः प्रसह्य हृतवान्कन्यां धर्मेण पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: It is my view that the son of Kunti saw these faults; therefore the Pandava took the maiden by force, in accordance with dharma.

verses.text:
उचितश्चैव संबन्धः सुभद्रा च यशस्विनी ।
एष चापीदृशः पार्थः प्रसह्य हृतवानिति ॥

meaning.en: The connection is a fitting one, and Subhadra is renowned; and Partha, being such a man, carried her off by force.

verses.text:
भरतस्यान्वये जातं शंतनोश्च महात्मनः ।
कुन्तिभोजात्मजापुत्रं को बुभूषेत नार्जुनम् ॥

meaning.en: Born in the line of Bharata and of great-souled Shantanu, the son of Kunti, who was Kuntibhoja's daughter, who would not wish for Arjuna as kinsman?

verses.text:
न च पश्यामि यः पार्थं विक्रमेण पराजयेत् ।
अपि सर्वेषु लोकेषु सेन्द्ररुद्रेषु मारिष ॥

meaning.en: I see no one who could defeat Partha in valor, sir, in all the worlds, even with Indra and Rudra included.

verses.text:
स च नाम रथस्तादृङ्मदीयास्ते च वाजिनः ।
योद्धा पार्थश्च शीघ्रास्त्रः को नु तेन समो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: And that chariot is such, those horses are mine, and Partha is a warrior of swift weapons; who could be his equal?

verses.text:
तमनुद्रुत्य सान्त्वेन परमेण धनंजयम् ।
निवर्तयध्वं संहृष्टा ममैषा परमा मतिः ॥

meaning.en: So follow him and bring Dhananjaya back with the utmost conciliation, gladly; this is my best counsel.

verses.text:
यदि निर्जित्य वः पार्थो बलाद्गच्छेत्स्वकं पुरम् ।
प्रणश्येद्वो यशः सद्यो न तु सान्त्वे पराजयः ॥

meaning.en: If Partha defeated you and went by force to his own city, your fame would be lost at once; but there is no defeat in conciliation.

verses.text:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वासुदेवस्य तथा चक्रुर्जनाधिप ।
निवृत्तश्चार्जुनस्तत्र विवाहं कृतवांस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Vasudeva, they did so, O lord of men. Arjuna turned back, and then married her there.

verses.text:
उषित्वा तत्र कौन्तेयः संवत्सरपराः क्षपाः ।
पुष्करेषु ततः शिष्टं कालं वर्तितवान्प्रभुः ।
पूर्णे तु द्वादशे वर्षे खाण्डवप्रस्थमाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: Having stayed there for more than a year in the nights, the lord spent the remaining time at Pushkara; and when the twelfth year was complete he entered Khandavaprastha.

verses.text:
अभिगम्य स राजानं विनयेन समाहितः ।
अभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणान्पार्थो द्रौपदीमभिजग्मिवान् ॥

meaning.en: Approaching the king, composed and humble, and honoring the Brahmins, Partha went to Draupadi.

verses.text:
तं द्रौपदी प्रत्युवाच प्रणयात्कुरुनन्दनम् ।
तत्रैव गच्छ कौन्तेय यत्र सा सात्वतात्मजा ।
सुबद्धस्यापि भारस्य पूर्वबन्धः श्लथायते ॥

meaning.en: Draupadi answered the joy of the Kurus out of love: Go there, son of Kunti, where that daughter of the Sattvatas is; for even a load well tied has its first knot loosened.

verses.text:
तथा बहुविधं कृष्णां विलपन्तीं धनंजयः ।
सान्त्वयामास भूयश्च क्षमयामास चासकृत् ॥

meaning.en: Thus Dhananjaya comforted Krishna as she lamented in many ways, and begged her pardon again and again.

verses.text:
सुभद्रां त्वरमाणश्च रक्तकौशेयवाससम् ।
पार्थः प्रस्थापयामास कृत्वा गोपालिकावपुः ॥

meaning.en: In haste Partha sent Subhadra, wearing red silk, disguised as a cowherd's wife.

verses.text:
साधिकं तेन रूपेण शोभमाना यशस्विनी ।
भवनं श्रेष्ठमासाद्य वीरपत्नी वराङ्गना ।
ववन्दे पृथुताम्राक्षी पृथां भद्रा यशस्विनी ॥

meaning.en: Even more beautiful in that guise, the renowned heroic wife, the fair woman with large coppery eyes, came to the finest house and bowed to Pritha, Bhadra the famous.

verses.text:
ततोऽभिगम्य त्वरिता पूर्णेन्दुसदृशानना ।
ववन्दे द्रौपदीं भद्रा प्रेष्याहमिति चाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, hurrying, with a face like the full moon, Bhadra went to Draupadi and bowed, saying, I am your servant.

verses.text:
प्रत्युत्थाय च तां कृष्णा स्वसारं माधवस्य ताम् ।
सस्वजे चावदत्प्रीता निःसपत्नोऽस्तु ते पतिः ।
तथैव मुदिता भद्रा तामुवाचैवमस्त्विति ॥

meaning.en: Krishna rose and embraced that sister of Madhava and said happily, May your husband have no rival. Bhadra, equally glad, replied, So be it.

verses.text:
ततस्ते हृष्टमनसः पाण्डवेया महारथाः ।
कुन्ती च परमप्रीता बभूव जनमेजय ॥

meaning.en: Then the great chariot-warrior Pandavas were glad at heart, and Kunti was supremely pleased, Janamejaya.

verses.text:
श्रुत्वा तु पुण्डरीकाक्षः संप्राप्तं स्वपुरोत्तमम् ।
अर्जुनं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठमिन्द्रप्रस्थगतं तदा ॥

meaning.en: The lotus-eyed one, hearing that Arjuna, the best of the Pandavas, had reached his own excellent city at Indraprastha,

verses.text:
आजगाम विशुद्धात्मा सह रामेण केशवः ।
वृष्ण्यन्धकमहामात्रैः सह वीरैर्महारथैः ॥

meaning.en: the pure-souled Keshava came with Rama, with the great ministers of the Vrishnis and Andhakas and heroic great chariot-warriors,

verses.text:
भ्रातृभिश्च कुमारैश्च योधैश्च शतशो वृतः ।
सैन्येन महता शौरिरभिगुप्तः परंतपः ॥

meaning.en: surrounded by hundreds of brothers, young princes and warriors, Shauri, scourge of foes, guarded by a great army.

verses.text:
तत्र दानपतिर्धीमानाजगाम महायशाः ।
अक्रूरो वृष्णिवीराणां सेनापतिररिंदमः ॥

meaning.en: There came the wise and greatly renowned lord of gifts, Akrura, subduer of foes and commander of the Vrishni heroes,

verses.text:
अनाधृष्टिर्महातेजा उद्धवश्च महायशाः ।
साक्षाद्बृहस्पतेः शिष्यो महाबुद्धिर्महायशाः ॥

meaning.en: mighty Anadhrishti, and greatly renowned Uddhava, the very pupil of Brihaspati, of great wisdom and fame,

verses.text:
सत्यकः सात्यकिश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः ।
प्रद्युम्नश्चैव साम्बश्च निशठः शङ्कुरेव च ॥

meaning.en: Satyaka and Satyaki, Kritavarman the Sattvata, Pradyumna and Samba, Nishatha and Shanku,

verses.text:
चारुदेष्णश्च विक्रान्तो झिल्ली विपृथुरेव च ।
सारणश्च महाबाहुर्गदश्च विदुषां वरः ॥

meaning.en: the valiant Charudeshna, Jhilli, Vipritthu, mighty-armed Sarana, and Gada, best of the learned.

verses.text:
एते चान्ये च बहवो वृष्णिभोजान्धकास्तथा ।
आजग्मुः खाण्डवप्रस्थमादाय हरणं बहु ॥

meaning.en: These and many other Vrishnis, Bhojas and Andhakas came to Khandavaprastha bringing many gifts.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा श्रुत्वा माधवमागतम् ।
प्रतिग्रहार्थं कृष्णस्य यमौ प्रास्थापयत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, hearing that Madhava had come, sent the twins to receive Krishna.

verses.text:
ताभ्यां प्रतिगृहीतं तद्वृष्णिचक्रं समृद्धिमत् ।
विवेश खाण्डवप्रस्थं पताकाध्वजशोभितम् ॥

meaning.en: Received by the two, that prosperous company of Vrishnis entered Khandavaprastha, which was adorned with flags and banners.

verses.text:
सिक्तसंमृष्टपन्थानं पुष्पप्रकरशोभितम् ।
चन्दनस्य रसैः शीतैः पुण्यगन्धैर्निषेवितम् ॥

meaning.en: Its roads were sprinkled and swept, adorned with heaps of flowers, and made fragrant with cool sandalwood essence of holy scent.

verses.text:
दह्यतागुरुणा चैव देशे देशे सुगन्धिना ।
सुसंमृष्टजनाकीर्णं वणिग्भिरुपशोभितम् ॥

meaning.en: Fragrant aloe burned in place after place, and the city was crowded with people well-groomed and adorned by merchants.

verses.text:
प्रतिपेदे महाबाहुः सह रामेण केशवः ।
वृष्ण्यन्धकमहाभोजैः संवृतः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty-armed Keshava, best of men, was welcomed with Rama, surrounded by Vrishnis, Andhakas and great Bhojas.

verses.text:
संपूज्यमानः पौरैश्च ब्राह्मणैश्च सहस्रशः ।
विवेश भवनं राज्ञः पुरंदरगृहोपमम् ॥

meaning.en: Honored by thousands of townsmen and Brahmins, he entered the king's palace, like the home of Purandara.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरस्तु रामेण समागच्छद्यथाविधि ।
मूर्ध्नि केशवमाघ्राय पर्यष्वजत बाहुना ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira met Rama in due form, and smelling Keshava's head, embraced him with his arm.

verses.text:
तं प्रीयमाणं कृष्णस्तु विनयेनाभ्यपूजयत् ।
भीमं च पुरुषव्याघ्रं विधिवत्प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥

meaning.en: Krishna honored him with humility as he rejoiced, and duly honored Bhima, the tiger among men.

verses.text:
तांश्च वृष्ण्यन्धकश्रेष्ठान्धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
प्रतिजग्राह सत्कारैर्यथाविधि यथोपगम् ॥

meaning.en: The Dharma-king Yudhishthira received those best of the Vrishnis and Andhakas with due honors, as each deserved.

verses.text:
गुरुवत्पूजयामास कांश्चित्कांश्चिद्वयस्यवत् ।
कांश्चिदभ्यवदत्प्रेम्णा कैश्चिदप्यभिवादितः ॥

meaning.en: He honored some as elders, some as friends, greeted some with affection, and was greeted by others in turn.

verses.text:
ततो ददौ वासुदेवो जन्यार्थे धनमुत्तमम् ।
हरणं वै सुभद्राया ज्ञातिदेयं महायशाः ॥

meaning.en: Then Vasudeva, greatly renowned, gave, for the wedding, excellent wealth, the bride-gift of Subhadra, a gift from kin.

verses.text:
रथानां काञ्चनाङ्गानां किङ्किणीजालमालिनाम् ।
चतुर्युजामुपेतानां सूतैः कुशलसंमतैः ।
सहस्रं प्रददौ कृष्णो गवामयुतमेव च ॥

meaning.en: He gave a thousand chariots with golden bodies, hung with garlands of bells, each with four horses and charioteers of proven skill, and ten thousand cows besides.

verses.text:
श्रीमान्माथुरदेश्यानां दोग्ध्रीणां पुण्यवर्चसाम् ।
वडवानां च शुभ्राणां चन्द्रांशुसमवर्चसाम् ।
ददौ जनार्दनः प्रीत्या सहस्रं हेमभूषणम् ॥

meaning.en: The glorious one gave, in love, a thousand gold-adorned mares of holy radiance from the land of Mathura, milch cows, and white mares shining like moonbeams.

verses.text:
तथैवाश्वतरीणां च दान्तानां वातरंहसाम् ।
शतान्यञ्जनकेशीनां श्वेतानां पञ्च पञ्च च ॥

meaning.en: He likewise gave tamed mules swift as the wind, with black eyes and manes, five hundred and fifty of them, white ones.

verses.text:
स्नापनोत्सादने चैव सुयुक्तं वयसान्वितम् ।
स्त्रीणां सहस्रं गौरीणां सुवेषाणां सुवर्चसाम् ॥

meaning.en: He gave a thousand fair-skinned women of suitable age, finely dressed and radiant, skilled in bathing and anointing,

verses.text:
सुवर्णशतकण्ठीनामरोगाणां सुवाससाम् ।
परिचर्यासु दक्षाणां प्रददौ पुष्करेक्षणः ॥

meaning.en: each with a hundred gold necklaces, healthy, well clothed and skilled in service; so gave the lotus-eyed one.

verses.text:
कृताकृतस्य मुख्यस्य कनकस्याग्निवर्चसः ।
मनुष्यभारान्दाशार्हो ददौ दश जनार्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Janardana, Dasharha, gave ten man-loads of finest gold, worked and unworked, shining like fire.

verses.text:
गजानां तु प्रभिन्नानां त्रिधा प्रस्रवतां मदम् ।
गिरिकूटनिकाशानां समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: He, fond of bold deeds, gave a thousand excellent elephants in rut, with three streams of ichor, like mountain peaks, never retreating from battle,

verses.text:
कॢप्तानां पटुघण्टानां वराणां हेममालिनाम् ।
हस्त्यारोहैरुपेतानां सहस्रं साहसप्रियः ॥

meaning.en: well harnessed, with sharp-sounding bells and golden garlands, with their mahouts.

verses.text:
रामः पादग्राहणिकं ददौ पार्थाय लाङ्गली ।
प्रीयमाणो हलधरः संबन्धप्रीतिमावहन् ॥

meaning.en: The plow-bearer Rama, pleased and bringing the joy of kinship, gave Partha a gift of foot-washing.

verses.text:
स महाधनरत्नौघो वस्त्रकम्बलफेनवान् ।
महागजमहाग्राहः पताकाशैवलाकुलः ॥

meaning.en: That great stream of vast wealth and jewels, foaming with cloth and blankets, with great elephants for crocodiles and banners for moss,

verses.text:
पाण्डुसागरमाविद्धः प्रविवेश महानदः ।
पूर्णमापूरयंस्तेषां द्विषच्छोकावहोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: rushed into the white ocean of the Pandavas, filling the full one, and brought grief to their enemies.

verses.text:
प्रतिजग्राह तत्सर्वं धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
पूजयामास तांश्चैव वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथान् ॥

meaning.en: The Dharma-king Yudhishthira accepted it all, and honored those great chariot-warriors of the Vrishnis and Andhakas.

verses.text:
ते समेता महात्मानः कुरुवृष्ण्यन्धकोत्तमाः ।
विजह्रुरमरावासे नराः सुकृतिनो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Those great-souled best of the Kurus, Vrishnis and Andhakas, gathered together, and enjoyed themselves in the home of the immortals like men of good deeds.

verses.text:
तत्र तत्र महापानैरुत्कृष्टतलनादितैः ।
यथायोगं यथाप्रीति विजह्रुः कुरुवृष्णयः ॥

meaning.en: In many places, with great drinking and the sound of clapping hands, the Kurus and Vrishnis enjoyed themselves as they pleased.

verses.text:
एवमुत्तमवीर्यास्ते विहृत्य दिवसान्बहून् ।
पूजिताः कुरुभिर्जग्मुः पुनर्द्वारवतीं पुरीम् ॥

meaning.en: So, having sported for many days, those of supreme valor, honored by the Kurus, returned to the city of Dvaravati.

verses.text:
रामं पुरस्कृत्य ययुर्वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथाः ।
रत्नान्यादाय शुभ्राणि दत्तानि कुरुसत्तमैः ॥

meaning.en: The great chariot-warriors of the Vrishnis and Andhakas went with Rama in front, taking the bright jewels given by the best of the Kurus.

verses.text:
वासुदेवस्तु पार्थेन तत्रैव सह भारत ।
उवास नगरे रम्ये शक्रप्रस्थे महामनाः ।
व्यचरद्यमुनाकूले पार्थेन सह भारत ॥

meaning.en: But Vasudeva, the great-minded, stayed there with Partha in the lovely city of Shakraprastha, O Bharata, and roamed with Partha on the banks of the Yamuna.

verses.text:
ततः सुभद्रा सौभद्रं केशवस्य प्रिया स्वसा ।
जयन्तमिव पौलोमी द्युतिमन्तमजीजनत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Subhadra, the dear sister of Keshava, bore a radiant son, the son of Subhadra, like Paulomi's son Jayanta.

verses.text:
दीर्घबाहुं महासत्त्वमृषभाक्षमरिंदमम् ।
सुभद्रा सुषुवे वीरमभिमन्युं नरर्षभम् ॥

meaning.en: Subhadra bore the hero Abhimanyu, a bull among men, long-armed, of great strength, with eyes like a bull's, a conqueror of foes.

verses.text:
अभीश्च मन्युमांश्चैव ततस्तमरिमर्दनम् ।
अभिमन्युमिति प्राहुरार्जुनिं पुरुषर्षभम् ॥

meaning.en: Because he was fearless and full of fury, scourge of enemies, they called him Abhimanyu, Arjuna's son, a bull among men.

verses.text:
स सात्वत्यामतिरथः संबभूव धनंजयात् ।
मखे निर्मथ्यमानाद्वा शमीगर्भाद्धुताशनः ॥

meaning.en: That atiratha was born to Dhananjaya from the Sattvata woman like the fire born from the churned shami wood in a sacrifice.

verses.text:
यस्मिञ्जाते महाबाहुः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
अयुतं गा द्विजातिभ्यः प्रादान्निष्कांश्च तावतः ॥

meaning.en: At his birth, Yudhishthira son of Kunti, mighty-armed, gave Brahmins ten thousand cows and as many nishkas.

verses.text:
दयितो वासुदेवस्य बाल्यात्प्रभृति चाभवत् ।
पितॄणां चैव सर्वेषां प्रजानामिव चन्द्रमाः ॥

meaning.en: From childhood he was dear to Vasudeva, and to all his forefathers, as the moon is to the creatures.

verses.text:
जन्मप्रभृति कृष्णश्च चक्रे तस्य क्रियाः शुभाः ।
स चापि ववृधे बालः शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी ॥

meaning.en: From his birth Krishna performed the auspicious rites for him, and the boy grew like the moon in the bright fortnight.

verses.text:
चतुष्पादं दशविधं धनुर्वेदमरिंदमः ।
अर्जुनाद्वेद वेदज्ञात्सकलं दिव्यमानुषम् ॥

meaning.en: The subduer of foes learned from Arjuna, who knew the Vedas, the whole fourfold, tenfold science of the bow, divine and human.

verses.text:
विज्ञानेष्वपि चास्त्राणां सौष्ठवे च महाबलः ।
क्रियास्वपि च सर्वासु विशेषानभ्यशिक्षयत् ॥

meaning.en: Strong, he mastered the knowledge of weapons and their skillful handling, and took special training in every skill.

verses.text:
आगमे च प्रयोगे च चक्रे तुल्यमिवात्मनः ।
तुतोष पुत्रं सौभद्रं प्रेक्षमाणो धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: In theory and in practice Arjuna made him like himself, and he rejoiced at seeing his son Subhadra's child.

verses.text:
सर्वसंहननोपेतं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् ।
दुर्धर्षमृषभस्कन्धं व्यात्ताननमिवोरगम् ॥

meaning.en: He was endowed with every strength of body and marked with every auspicious sign, unassailable, with bull-like shoulders, like a snake with open mouth,

verses.text:
सिंहदर्पं महेष्वासं मत्तमातङ्गविक्रमम् ।
मेघदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननम् ॥

meaning.en: with a lion's pride, a great archer, with the might of a rutting elephant, a voice like thunder and drums, a face like the full moon.

verses.text:
कृष्णस्य सदृशं शौर्ये वीर्ये रूपे तथाकृतौ ।
ददर्श पुत्रं बीभत्सुर्मघवानिव तं यथा ॥

meaning.en: Equal to Krishna in heroism, valor, beauty and form, Bibhatsu saw his son as Indra might see his own.

verses.text:
पाञ्चाल्यपि च पञ्चभ्यः पतिभ्यः शुभलक्षणा ।
लेभे पञ्च सुतान्वीराञ्शुभान्पञ्चाचलानिव ॥

meaning.en: The auspicious Panchali also bore five heroic sons by her five husbands, like five bright mountains.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरात्प्रतिविन्ध्यं सुतसोमं वृकोदरात् ।
अर्जुनाच्छ्रुतकर्माणं शतानीकं च नाकुलिम् ॥

meaning.en: From Yudhishthira, Prativindhya; from Vrikodara, Sutasoma; from Arjuna, Shrutakarma; from Nakula, Shatanika,

verses.text:
सहदेवाच्छ्रुतसेनमेतान्पञ्च महारथान् ।
पाञ्चाली सुषुवे वीरानादित्यानदितिर्यथा ॥

meaning.en: and from Sahadeva, Shrutasena; these five great chariot-warriors Panchali bore, heroes like the Adityas born to Aditi.

verses.text:
शास्त्रतः प्रतिविन्ध्यं तमूचुर्विप्रा युधिष्ठिरम् ।
परप्रहरणज्ञाने प्रतिविन्ध्यो भवत्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: The Brahmins said by the scriptures that Yudhishthira's son should be named Prativindhya, because he would resist the weapons of enemies.

verses.text:
सुते सोमसहस्रे तु सोमार्कसमतेजसम् ।
सुतसोमं महेष्वासं सुषुवे भीमसेनतः ॥

meaning.en: When Soma-sacrifices numbering a thousand had been performed, she bore Bhimasena a son of Soma-and-sun radiance, the great archer Sutasoma.

verses.text:
श्रुतं कर्म महत्कृत्वा निवृत्तेन किरीटिना ।
जातः पुत्रस्तवेत्येवं श्रुतकर्मा ततोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Because he was born when Kiritin returned after a great deed that became famed, they named him Shrutakarma, the Son of the Heard Deed.

verses.text:
शतानीकस्य राजर्षेः कौरव्यः कुरुनन्दनः ।
चक्रे पुत्रं सनामानं नकुलः कीर्तिवर्धनम् ॥

meaning.en: Nakula, the Kaurava and joy of the Kurus, gave his son the name of the royal sage Shatanika, to spread his fame.

verses.text:
ततस्त्वजीजनत्कृष्णा नक्षत्रे वह्निदैवते ।
सहदेवात्सुतं तस्माच्छ्रुतसेनेति तं विदुः ॥

meaning.en: Then Krishna bore a son to Sahadeva under a star whose deity is fire; therefore they know him as Shrutasena.

verses.text:
एकवर्षान्तरास्त्वेव द्रौपदेया यशस्विनः ।
अन्वजायन्त राजेन्द्र परस्परहिते रताः ॥

meaning.en: These renowned sons of Draupadi were each born a year apart, O king of kings, devoted to one another's good.

verses.text:
जातकर्माण्यानुपूर्व्याच्चूडोपनयनानि च ।
चकार विधिवद्धौम्यस्तेषां भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Dhaumya, as is proper, performed their birth rites, tonsure and initiation in order, O best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
कृत्वा च वेदाध्ययनं ततः सुचरितव्रताः ।
जगृहुः सर्वमिष्वस्त्रमर्जुनाद्दिव्यमानुषम् ॥

meaning.en: Having studied the Vedas and kept their vows well, they all learned from Arjuna the whole of the divine and human science of archery.

verses.text:
देवगर्भोपमैः पुत्रैर्व्यूढोरस्कैर्महाबलैः ।
अन्विता राजशार्दूल पाण्डवा मुदमाप्नुवन् ॥

meaning.en: With those sons like children of the gods, broad-chested and mighty, O tiger among kings, the Pandavas found joy.
